description: Source code for the ProjectInfo class in Drupal, handling operations related to drupal.org project data, including processing module/theme info lists, determining project names, and filtering project info.

classes.name: ProjectInfo
classes.description: Performs operations on drupal.org project data, including processing info lists, determining project names, and filtering project info.

methods.name: processInfoList
methods.description: Populates an array of project data by processing a list of installed modules or themes, grouping them by project and status.

methods.name: getProjectName
methods.description: Determines the canonical project short name for a given extension file.

methods.name: filterProjectInfo
methods.description: Filters the project .info.yml data to only include necessary attributes for update status.
